visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with short grey hair and a grey Under Armour sweatshirt is seen face-down on a light-colored wooden desk. A white keyboard, mouse, and several small decorative items like a Mario mushroom figurine are scattered around. The background is a plain white wall. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the person's face; a hand reaches into the frame and presses their forehead, causing their brows to furrow. The person's eyes look sad and downcast. (3) The individual sits upright in a beige chair, looking directly into the lens with a look of frustration. (4) The person is positioned against a white wall, repeatedly banging their forehead against it with a rhythmic motion. (5) The scene shifts to a hair salon setting where a stylist wearing a white knitted sweater and a black apron is seen applying grey hair dye to the person's hair. The person is sitting sideways and looking ahead. (6) A green fern leaf is in the foreground. The person steps out from behind a white partition into a brightly lit hallway, revealing a fresh purple-grey bowl-cut hairstyle and a confident smile. (7) A rapid montage follows showing the person posing playfully, touching their new hair, and making various cute facial expressions and hand gestures towards the camera in a studio-like environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice asking a question in a soft tone, accompanied by low-energy, slightly melancholic BGM. (2) The main speaker responds with an exaggeratedly whiny and high-pitched vocal quality, expressing dissatisfaction with her appearance. (3) A series of rhythmic, percussive thudding sounds occur as the character hits her head on the wall. (4) A bright, ascending melodic jingle ('Do Re Mi So') marks the transition to the makeover scene, with the sound of a camera shutter or clapboard. (5) Upbeat, high-tempo pop music swells with energetic female vocals in English. (6) The main speaker's voice returns, now with a high-arousal, confident, and playful tone, speaking rapidly over the driving beat. (7) Various short 'whoosh' and 'pop' SFX are layered over the music as visual cuts occur, ending with a final stylized vocal flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'before and after' narrative to showcase a hair transformation. It begins with the protagonist feeling 'ugly' and acting out dramatically, followed by a transition to a salon visit, and concludes with a high-energy montage of the protagonist feeling beautiful and confident with their new hair color and style.
